title: VK-only Write Multiple Registers
purpose: Exercise the interaction among register quantity, byte count, multi-register data, and MBAP length in a compact valid write request.

messages.label: write two registers with four data bytes

expected_behavior: The server should parse the complete multi-register request and normally return a Write Multiple Registers confirmation containing the starting address and quantity.
constraints_preserved: MBAP length 000b equals unit identifier plus the ten-byte PDU.
Quantity 2 and byte count 4 agree with the four data bytes.
issue_safety_notes: This targets field-consistency and reply handling associated with reported server issues while keeping all visible lengths internally consistent. It is an analogue, not an exact issue reproducer, and no externally verified root cause is claimed.
